LanguageData.Lumen_Info_SupportRule: Each fixture category counts once in an enclosed room, at its highest weight. Floor and wall lamps share the lamp category, and duplicates add nothing. Support is capped at 100%.
LanguageData.Lumen_Info_SolarRule: This is a Solar active effect: it runs only while the fixture's Solar active effect is toggled on and the map has Solar energy.
